title: Tech Note: The 4D remote FastCGI Component

historical_commentary.text: FastCGI-based integration of the kind described here has been largely superseded by 4D's own mature, built-in web server, which now handles dynamic web content generation directly without requiring a separate FastCGI component, making this note's architecture obsolete for current 4D web deployments.
related_updates: 4D's own built-in web server has long superseded the need for a separate remote FastCGI component for serving dynamic 4D-driven web content
